name: Login Page
fields: Email or username, Password; safe error on failure

name: Dashboard
buttons: Upload resume, Start a new interview
fields: Completed interviews, most recent score, average score (when enough), recent interviews, role-wise performance, strengths and weak topics, suggested practice

name: Resume Upload and Analysis
buttons: Choose file, Upload, Edit, Confirm, Replace, Delete resume
fields: Current resume file name, skills, education, projects, experience, certifications; unsupported or unreadable file message

name: Job Role Recommendation
fields: Role recommendations with a short reason for each

name: Interview Configuration
fields: Role, interview type (Technical, HR, Behavioral, Project-based), difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard), duration (configured options)

name: Interview Room
buttons: Replay, Mute, Record answer, Submit answer, End interview, View report
fields: Time left, question number, 2D interviewer avatar (idle, speaking, listening), question text, typed answer, transcript

name: Interview Result
fields: Overall score out of 100, category scores, strengths, areas for improvement, suggestions; practice-estimate note

name: Interview History
fields: Previous interview sessions with role, date and score
